intro.summary: West-end community on the cliff above the Bow River along Bow Trail SW, mostly apartments and condos with a pocket of detached homes.
intro.body: Spruce Cliff sits on the escarpment above the Bow River along Bow Trail SW, close to the West LRT line and the river pathways. Most homes here are units in apartment and condo buildings. A smaller area of single-detached and semi-detached homes sits back from the cliff.
